question: 统计每位客户 2025-01 的 debit 交易数，包括零次客户。
initial_sql: SELECT c.id, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.account_id=a.id AND t.txn_type='debit' AND t.txn_date>='2025-01-01' AND t.txn_date<'2025-02-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, COUNT(t.id) AS txn_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.account_id=a.id AND t.txn_type='debit' AND t.txn_date>='2025-01-01' AND t.txn_date<'2025-02-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id

question: 统计每位客户 2025-01 的 debit 总额，包括零金额客户。
initial_sql: SELECT c.id, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) AS total_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.account_id=a.id WHERE t.txn_type='debit' AND t.txn_date>='2025-01-01' AND t.txn_date<'2025-02-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='debit' AND t.txn_date>='2025-01-01' AND t.txn_date<'2025-02-01' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.account_id=a.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id
